title: Top entity instantiates a parametric sub-entity via `entity work.X generic map (…) port map (…)`
sourceUrl: internal: Kmila audit F-G-05 (2026-07-12) — direct-entity instantiation with generic override
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Top entity `gen_inst_top` instantiates a parametric counter sub-entity using the VHDL-2008 direct-instantiation form with a `generic map` clause: `u_cnt : entity work.counter_n generic map (WIDTH => 8) port map (...)`. The generic overrides the child's WIDTH=4 default so the observable output matches case 132's 8-bit counter. Regression coverage for audit F-G-05 — the Kmila interpreter's `SyntetizeBehaviour` used to swallow the `entity` keyword and route the rest through the signal-assignment path, throwing `Unexpected token 'generic' after 'work.counter_n'`. Fix landed 2026-07-12: `case "entity":` added to the KEYWORDS switch in `Interpreter/Services/Architecture.cs`.
